test_Signature_constructor: test the Signature class constructor to extract function names and arguments from callable objects
test_Signature_get_free_parameters: test the Signature get_free_parameters method to find unfilled parameters given positional args and kwargs
test_Signature_construct_arguments: test the Signature construct_arguments method to build validated arg and kwarg tuples for a function
test_Signature_construct_arguments_error: test the Signature construct_arguments method to raise TypeError on unexpected or duplicate arguments
test_Signature_string_repr: test the Signature class string and repr output to display function signatures with defaults and varargs
